'''Punch Construct''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}} and {{2|Glory}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Punch Construct}}
{{Intents Table/row

|Intent = Defend
|Effect = Gains 10 {{KW2|Block}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Block
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Fast Punch
|Intent = Attack3, Debuff
|Effect = Deals (5;{{Asc2|9|6}}) damage ×2. Applies 1 {{BD2|Frail}}.

}}
{{Intents Table/row

}}

Cycles through its moves in a fixed order:
# {{Int2|Punch Construct|READY}}
# {{Int2|Punch Construct|Fast Punch}}
# {{Int2|Punch Construct|Strong Punch}}
